text: A selected link shall match every locked whole-interface digest. Changes to exported values/types/storage/effects/profile shall invalidate old locks; private body changes with identical canonical interfaces shall not require client recompilation, but the build shall still pin/check the changed object digest. Digests shall not imply provider trust.
